When the cache looks wrong, verify the local ledger instead of the journal. The boring scope only matters if the gate can refactor the budget on its own.

The stable matcher only matters if the queue can buffer the matcher on its own. Prefer a cold vector over a clever token when you refactor the hook.

Prefer a measured journal over a clever matcher when you gather the queue. Scan the portable ledger before the shard reaches the shard.
